name: jack-of-guns
description: Browser voxel FPS — Ace of Spades spiritual successor (Three.js + Rust/WASM)

scripts.wasm: cargo build -p voxel-wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/voxel_wasm.wasm
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
